name: Stochastic Processes and its Applications
description: Stochastic processes and their classifications, stationary, memoryless and martingales properties, simple stochastic processes, discrete and continuous time Markov chains, Poisson process, birth-death process, simple queueing models, solution techniques, point process, renewal process, Monte-Carlo simulation, random number generation, simulation of stochastic processes, modeling on system reliability, block diagram, fault tree and Markov methods, simulation methods.
